name: parallax-layer
title: Parallax Layer
description: A layer that travels at its own pace while the page scrolls past, with optional zoom and turn.
docs: Put layers with different speeds in one relatively positioned section. Keep speeds between -0.6 and 0.6 for text, and use the stronger values for shapes and images. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.
